clues.it: Irene era nella 5ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e a nord di Nino.
clues.en: Irene was in the 5th column, in the 1st row and north of Nino.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Bruno era l'unico seduto su una sedia e a nord di Nino.
clues.en: Bruno was the only one sitting on a chair and north of Nino.

clues.it: Marta era nella 6ª colonna e nella stessa stanza di Rosa.
clues.en: Marta was in the 6th column and in the same room as Rosa.

clues.it: Rosa era accanto a un pianoforte a coda e nella Suite Reale.
clues.en: Rosa was beside a grand piano and in the Royal Suite.

clues.it: Giada era nella 10ª colonna, nella 6ª riga e nella Suite Reale, ma non era accanto a un tappeto persiano.
clues.en: Giada was in the 10th column, in the 6th row and in the Royal Suite, but was not beside a persian carpet.

clues.it: Nino era nella 11ª colonna e nella stessa stanza di Ugo.
clues.en: Nino was in the 11th column and in the same room as Ugo.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 8ª riga, accanto a un baule da viaggio e al Ristorante.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 8th row, beside a steamer trunk and in the Restaurant.

clues.it: Fabio era nella Sala da Ballo, ma non era accanto a un lampadario.
clues.en: Fabio was in the Ballroom, but was not beside a chandelier.

clues.it: Carla era accanto a un baule da viaggio e nella stessa stanza di Bruno.
clues.en: Carla was beside a steamer trunk and in the same room as Bruno.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 8ª colonna, nella 11ª riga e a ovest di Giada.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 8th column, in the 11th row and west of Giada.

steps.en: Irene's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 5th.
